text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you doing over in that 
corner all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, but they seem to be in trouble 
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be that you want to play with 
the kids playing tag over there?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Then let's go with Big Sis and ask 
if we can join in!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, everyone! Can we join in your 
game of tag too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Then Big Sis will be the tagger! 
Everyone, run, run~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna catch all of you! 
Wait up, wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That got way more heated than I 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, is it already this late!? I totally 
forgot about training!!

And so, Ines Fujin ended up skipping her 
training session.
